verse.verse_1: By the fig and the olive!
verse.verse_4: Indeed, We created the human with the fairest stature
verse.verse_5: and We shall return him to the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: except the believers who do good works, for theirs shall be an unfailing recompense.
verse.verse_7: So, what then shall belie you concerning the Recompense?
verse.verse_8: Is Allah not the Most Just of judges!
